description: Renovate owns dependency updates. Tested updates merge after the release soak; unresolved maintenance is reported by the maintenance workflows. See .github/MAINTENANCE.md.

packageRules.description: Automerge minor/patch bumps and pin/digest refreshes once CI is green; rebase onto main first so CI ran against the current base
Attempt major updates automatically after a week; CI must pass before merge
Pre-1.0 updates use the same required CI gate
Our own published image needs no cooldown - digest re-pins should land immediately
Supply-chain soak: never automerge a GitHub Actions digest change. A moved tag on a SHA-pinned action shows up as a digest update; a human compares it against the upstream release first
Renovate engine: several releases a day, so take the weekly one; no digest pin because the annotated RENOVATE_VERSION env var holds a plain tag
Keep Node image, CI runtime, and Node types in one tested PR

customManagers.description: Bump the CODEX_VERSION pin in the Dockerfile (the marker comment above the ARG names the datasource)
